name: Plain White
shade: Flat bright white, no cast.

name: Ivory White
shade: Off-white with a warm ivory or cream cast; still reads white, never beige.

name: Bright Silver
shade: Bright clean light metallic, neutral to faintly cool.

name: Champagne Silver
shade: Light metallic with a warm champagne or pinkish cast; the name of every member says so.

name: Violet Silver
shade: Light-to-mid metallic with a clear violet cast. The entry rests on the colours' own names, not on a heading: every member is called purplish something.

name: Ash Grey
shade: Pale-to-mid grey, flatter and less lustrous than a silver; neutral to faintly warm.

name: Bronze Grey
shade: Mid grey metallic with a faint warm bronze cast, deliberately un-flashy.

name: Gunmetal
shade: Dark charcoal metallic with a cool blue cast; near-black in shade, clearly blue-grey in sun.

name: Black
shade: Plain black, from flat solid to a fine pearl or metallic flake.

name: Blue Black
shade: Near-black with a deep blue cast; reads black in shade, blue-black in sun.

name: Sand Beige
shade: Pale-to-mid warm sand; reads beige, never white.

name: Warm Brown
shade: Warm brown, from a soft creamy mid brown to a near-black bronze-brown.

name: Ochre Gold
shade: Warm ochre-gold metallic, tan-leaning rather than a bright modern gold.

name: Bright Red
shade: Bright saturated red, from neutral to slightly orange-leaning.

name: Deep Red
shade: Deep rich red, darker and more restrained than a fire-engine red; still unmistakably red.

name: Maroon
shade: Deep dark red-brown, close to burgundy, near-black in shade.

name: Dusk Rose
shade: Muted dusky rose; a pink-brown or pink-red with the saturation taken out.

name: Vivid Orange
shade: Vivid saturated orange, from yellow-leaning to true orange.

name: Vivid Yellow
shade: Vivid saturated yellow, no softening.

name: Soft Yellow
shade: Warm yellow with the edge off it: creamy, golden or pearl-deep rather than acid.

name: Lime
shade: Yellow-leaning green, from an acid lime to a pale mint.

name: Grass Green
shade: Mid true green, neither dark nor muted.

name: Sage Green
shade: Muted olive or grey-green; the green cast is clear but the colour is not.

name: Dark Green
shade: Very dark green, near-black in low light.

name: Deep Teal
shade: Deep blue-green: reads neither blue nor green cleanly.

name: Light Turquoise
shade: Light turquoise: a blue-green pale enough to read as neither.

name: Pale Blue
shade: Pale sky or ice blue, low saturation.

name: Mid Blue
shade: Bright mid-toned blue, clean and vivid; lighter than a royal blue and nowhere near navy.

name: Deep Blue
shade: Deep saturated blue, rich and lustrous; dark but still plainly blue, not navy.

name: Navy
shade: Very dark blue, near-black in shade.

name: Violet Blue
shade: Blue with a clear violet cast; still reads blue.

name: Deep Purple
shade: Deep purple pearl with pinkish-violet highlights; near-black in low light, unmistakably purple in daylight. Does not colour-shift.

name: Shifting Purple
shade: Deep rich purple that shifts with viewing angle: green in direct sun, purple through the mid-angles, bronze at the panel edges.

name: Shifting Purple, Gold
shade: Lighter and bluer than the above, with a fine gold-bronze flake; reads deep violet or blue-purple with gold highlights depending on the light.
